Could a familiar door make a nursing home feel more like home? In some Dutch care homes, it does.

Staff put life-size stickers of residents’ original front doors on their room entrances. Suddenly, a corridor full of lookalike doors has a few familiar faces - or, well, doors.

Called True Doors, the custom decals help residents with dementia find their rooms, feel less disoriented and reconnect with personal memories. Caregivers say they can also support independence and dignity, while making rooms feel warmer and more comforting.

Sometimes, a little piece of home is just one door away.
